workstreams.name: Autonomous Rule Suite Optimization Engine
workstreams.description: Engineered an autonomous end-to-end pipeline that auto-generates SQL queries and data extraction scripts over rolling 6-month data lakes to produce human-interpretable rule sets.
details: Custom adaptive-floor beam search algorithm with dynamic pruning
AUC-ROC evaluation to identify and incorporate high-value unutilized features
Benchmarked against RIPPER, CN2, and standard Decision Trees
Configurable search parameters (tree depth, beam width, custom optimization goals)
Automated monthly re-optimization loop to discover emerging fraud patterns
impact_metrics: Increased precision by a factor of 1.5x
Increased fraud detection recall by 3 percentage points (+3 pp) to 99.3%

workstreams.name: Multi-Entity Linkage & Resolution Graph
workstreams.description: Constructed an identity resolution graph on AWS SageMaker across 90K organizations and 91K edges over 21 link vectors to uncover 'seen offenders' and syndicate networks.
details: C1 Signals (Direct Entity Identifiers): KYC phone number, physical address, legal name, SSN/EIN
C2 Signals (Behavioral & Transactional): Shared counterparty networks, circular payment loops, interaction graphs
Dynamic mobile IP scrubbing and noisy edge filtering to eliminate false-positive linkage clusters
Normalization and standardization of identity vectors across heterogeneous databases
Random Forest classification tuned via exhaustive GridSearch on graph topological and nodal features
Automated weekly batch retraining and scheduled SageMaker inference jobs
Weekly automated blocking reports for preexisting and newly onboarded orgs
impact_metrics: Achieved 93.5% precision and 99.4% recall on graph entity linkage
Linked 231 of 1,645 fraudulent organizations to known prohibited entities
Identified $213K of $660K FY27 fraud exposure as preventable

workstreams.name: GenAI Operational Investigation Agent
workstreams.description: Integrated a Claude-powered agent utilizing function/tool-calling to automate investigation queues and provide context summaries for Risk Ops teams.
details: Tool-calling interface to execute automated fanout searches across linked entity clusters
Generated natural language summaries of macro-cluster topologies and micro-cluster details
Automated synthesis of entity-specific attributes: Total Payment Volume (TPV), tenure, dispute rates, return history
Google Apps Script automation to streamline investigation queue processing for risk ops

workstreams.name: Distributed Analytics, BI Dashboards & Anomaly Monitoring
workstreams.description: Established the centralized analytical source of truth from scratch for a product line lacking reporting infrastructure and deployed automated production drift alerting.
details: Authored complex distributed SQL queries in Starburst/Trino over multi-terabyte federated tables (complex multi-table joins, partitioned queries)
Built 8 production KPI dashboards in Tableau and DataVisor with calculated fields, dynamic aggregations, and tables
Deployed scheduled daily AWS SageMaker monitoring jobs querying Starburst
Z-score statistical anomaly detection with seasonal controls for dispute spikes and volume drift
Automated Slack alerting integrations for real-time risk drift visibility

workstreams.name: Domain-Specific Technical Consultation Bot
workstreams.description: Prompt-engineered and deployed a GPT-based conversational interface for the company website to automate technical requirement gathering for cryo-electron microscopy (cryoEM) hardware/software workstations.
details: Domain-specific prompt engineering covering cryoEM software dependencies and GPU/RAM/storage hardware configurations
Automated extraction of laboratory customer requirements to match compute budgets with optimized workstation specs
Frontend web integration for interactive customer onboarding

workstreams.name: Data Science Workstation Benchmarking & Architecture Profiling
workstreams.description: Researched sector-specific data science workflows, emulated computational pipelines, and identified hardware bottlenecks across CPU, RAM, and storage to inform workstation specs.
details: Researched and mapped data science computational requirements across diverse industry verticals
Simulated real-world ML/DS workloads using Python and Scikit-Learn (algorithmic compute vs. memory bandwidth vs. disk I/O)
Empirical hardware bottleneck profiling (CPU clock speed vs. multi-core scaling vs. RAM capacity vs. NVMe throughput)
impact_metrics: Delivered quantitative benchmark reports informing workstation configurations, improving simulated workflow efficiency by 20%

projects.name: DE-HNN: Graph Neural Network Optimization for Circuit Netlists
projects.publication_context: AIStats 2024 paper: 'DE-HNN: An effective neural model for Circuit Netlist representation' (Z. Luo et al.)
details: SKY130-HS RocketTile Data / Superblue Netlists (400K to 1.3M nodes and nets per netlist)
Bipartite graph, Directed Hypergraph, Star graph representations
Top-10 Laplacian Eigenvectors (LapPE) and Persistent Homology Diagrams (PD) for topological node features
Net-based Wirelength Regression, Demand Regression, and Cell-based Congestion Classification tasks
Evaluated Directed GCN, Linear Transformer + LapPE, GraphGPS positional encodings, Virtual Nodes
engineering_optimizations: Full model with Virtual Nodes required >40GB VRAM on NVIDIA A100, triggering OOM failures.
Implemented systematic architecture profiling and hyperparameter tuning.
impact_metrics: 38.8% reduction in peak GPU memory usage
Delivered final model with only a 6% average performance drop while drastically lowering compute costs

projects.name: Geospatial Analysis & Coordinate Mapping Pipeline
details: Ingested, cleaned, and transformed large-scale geospatial coordinate datasets across Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS)
Constructed multi-layer density heatmaps and spatial boundary visualizations across the United States
Implemented spatial indexing, point-in-polygon querying, and non-parametric filtering to clean noisy GPS/coordinate streams and resolve ambiguous spatial cluster classifications
